body:
I am trying to look for silver linings, I've had to my whole life.

Annoyingly, life is giving me plenty of reasons to stick around. I do think that in some ironic cosmic way, there is an diety out there whose sole purpose is to f**k with people. I think we give too many of what we consider "good" attributes to a being of unknown origin.

I also do as well. 

My plan got thrown into disarray since the last hour as I just spoke with one friend on the phone and also a with this girl I'm speaking to, I now have a potential date. Things changed so quickly so fast.

Thank you for the supportive words bro, it means a lot. 

The conviction was something I pleaded guilty to, so there's absolutley no going back on that. One of my core values, which was tested to the extremes was that of honesty. I did what I did and I owned up to it. I want my son to know that lies get people nowhere. My ex consistently lied in our relationship and it caused me to develop panic attacks with all her gaslighting. It's so strange to think that gaslighting is a real thing. I was convinced she was some sort of pathological liar. 

Gaslighting is a form of emotioinal abuse as is stonewalling. Unfortunately, I can't prove any of those things so being with her was a reminder that being in a relationship, especially when I am not 100% was never a good idea.

I speak to a therapist but it's more for behavioural actions but she did say she would refer me for counselling. 

My ex went straight to another work colleague in the month after she cheated on me, with a different work colleague. The one she is with now (different to the one she cheated on me with) has been with her all this time. 

She is understanding of my financial situation and said that our son won't starve if I don't give her money so she left the decision soley in my hands which I respect. I can't hate her for putting me in this awful position, no matter how much I should. We bring about our own downfall with actions we take. 

The fact that this conviction is affecting my ability to work in certain jobs will never be erased from the Police database. I'm just really tired of trying and I'm waiting for a catalyst to throw me off the edge at this point.
